user_query: Please verify the email address john.doe@example.com. I am particularly interested in knowing if it is a disposable email and if the SMTP step is enabled for this verification. Also, I would like to receive the general account information, including the email of the account owner and available credits.

TaskList.description: Verify if the email address john.doe@example.com is a disposable email address.
Check if the SMTP step is enabled for verification of the email address.
Retrieve general account information including the email of the account owner and available credits.
